name: Hiasler Hof
beschreibung: The Hiasler Hof is a traditional inn in Tirol, Österreich. It is located in a quiet location with a view of the surrounding mountains. The rooms are simply and comfortably furnished. The dining room offers regional dishes and drinks. The surrounding area is ideal for hiking in summer and skiing in winter. Guests can use the inn as a starting point for excursions into nature. The establishment is family-run and values Tiroler hospitality.
